turns.design_rationale: Symmetric double-parallelogram with two floating intermediate stages and central output. Four long thin flexures in series-parallel on each side give low transverse stiffness for >3mm stroke at 5N while paired top/bottom beams cancel rotation and axial chord-shortening is distributed across two stages, keeping parasitic dx and theta low. 0.7mm thickness satisfies min feature and keeps stress below 25MPa in polypropylene.
repair_log: No repairs needed. Design passed unit and envelope checks.

turns.design_rationale: Increase compliance to fix 0.78mm stroke deficit: minimize thickness to strict limit 0.6mm and maximize beam length to envelope limits (86mm span, ~40mm per side). Keep symmetric double-parallelogram with tall intermediate stage so lower ground-intermediate and upper intermediate-output beams stay horizontal for pure Y motion, preserving zero parasitic dx/theta. Lower stiffness raises stroke ~2x while thinner leaves keep stress below 25MPa.
repair_log: No repairs needed. Design passed unit and envelope checks.
